description: Fixed `aspire add`, `aspire integration list`, and `aspire integration search` returning no results in polyglot (non-C#) AppHosts because the polyglot compatibility filter relied on `tags:polyglot` NuGet queries that remote feeds don't answer reliably. The filter is now gated behind an off-by-default `features.polyglotIntegrationFilterEnabled` flag.
name: Gate polyglot integration filtering behind an off-by-default feature flag
